standard.ruleset_reference: Table G3.1-12 Proposed Building Performance column
standard.rule_description: These loads shall always be included in simulations of the building. These loads shall be included when calculating the proposed building performance and the baseline building performance as required by Section G1.2.1.

rule-12-5-a.test_description: A proposed building has one building segment and zone. Miscellaneous equipment is defined, has loads included, and has annual energy use.
